description: Na₇Al₄P₉O₃₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal P̅42₁c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.63 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.66 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.45 Å. Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-1.92 Å. There are three inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 41°. All P-O bond lengths are 1.53 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent AlO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-49°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.61 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-44°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.63 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃P tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Al and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two P atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one P atom.
